posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 3-4 high-contrast white spots observed on the lateral surface of the left hind leg; low-density grouping of 2 spots on the upper posterior haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral-lyrate curvature; horns emerge at a roughly 50-degree upward vector from the skull, curving laterally before turning inward and slightly posterior at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.5 times the pixel width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 12-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct high-contrast white spots located on the cheek area below the eye; a white transverse band across the bridge of the muzzle; long dark ventral fringe extending from the throat to the brisket.
